metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Cassini I/F observations projected onto the released shape. Bounded photometric normalization reduces broad acquired shading; true cast shadows and unreliable geometry are withheld. Gray grid marks unobserved areas.

metadata.label: False color
metadata.coverage: Cassini IR1, GRN, UV3 filters displayed as red, green and blue; observed illumination and common coverage only.

celestial.sunSource: Vendored JPL satellite orbit and a source-owned approximate IAU pole/spin presentation; source images use the independent PDS model camera geometry.

panel.introduction: Pan orbits inside the Encke Gap of Saturn’s A ring. Its gravity helps keep the gap open. Cassini revealed a small icy body surrounded by a broad equatorial ridge.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini I/F observations projected onto the released shape. Bounded photometric normalization reduces broad acquired shading; true cast shadows and unreliable geometry are withheld. Gray grid marks unobserved areas.
controls.title: ISS mosaic
controls.summary: Photographs are mapped onto the measured shape. Shadows and unreliable samples are withheld; the gray grid marks gaps.

controls.label: False color
controls.description: Cassini IR1, GRN, UV3 filters displayed as red, green and blue; observed illumination and common coverage only.
controls.title: Cassini false color
controls.summary: Measured filter bands in false color; this does not reproduce human-visible color. Gray grid marks missing common coverage; photographed shadows remain.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 14 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. This includes the broad irregular shape; it is not height above a gravity-defined geoid. Fixed relief lighting shows slopes; shape uncertainties vary by region.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Height relative to a 14 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Accuracy varies by region.
